name: The World Geography Challenge
description: How well do you really know the world?

questions.question: What is the capital city of France?

answers.comment: Madrid is the capital of Spain.
Correct! Paris is the capital and largest city of France.
Rome is the capital of Italy.
Berlin is the capital of Germany.

questions.question: Which is the largest continent in the world by land area?
questions.hint: It is home to countries such as China, India and Russia.
questions.explanation: Asia covers approximately 44.6 million square kilometres, making it the largest continent.

answers.comment: Africa is the second-largest continent.
North America is the third-largest continent.
Correct! Asia is the largest continent by land area.
Europe is much smaller than Asia.

questions.question: What is the highest mountain in the world above sea level?
questions.hint: It lies in the Himalayas, on the border between Nepal and China.
questions.explanation: Mount Everest reaches approximately 8,849 metres above sea level.

answers.comment: K2 is the world's second-highest mountain above sea level.
Kilimanjaro is the highest mountain in Africa.
Correct! Mount Everest is the highest mountain above sea level.
Mont Blanc is the highest mountain in the Alps.

questions.question: Which river carries the greatest volume of water in the world?
questions.hint: It flows through the world's largest tropical rainforest.
questions.explanation: The Amazon River has the greatest discharge of any river on Earth.

answers.comment: The Nile is traditionally regarded as the world's longest river.
Correct! The Amazon carries more water than any other river.
The Mississippi is one of North America's major river systems.
The Yangtze is the longest river in Asia.

questions.question: Which is the largest ocean on Earth?

answers.comment: The Atlantic is the second-largest ocean.
The Indian Ocean is the third-largest ocean.
The Arctic Ocean is the smallest ocean.
Correct! The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean.

questions.question: Which African country has the largest population?
questions.hint: Its largest city is Lagos, although its capital is Abuja.
questions.explanation: Nigeria is Africa's most populous country, with a population exceeding 200 million.

answers.comment: Egypt is one of Africa's most populous countries, but it is not the largest by population.
South Africa has a large population, but Nigeria has more people.
Correct! Nigeria is Africa's most populous country.
Ethiopia is highly populous, but Nigeria has a larger population.

questions.question: Which is the largest desert in the world?
questions.hint: A desert is defined by its lack of precipitation, not by how hot it is.
questions.explanation: Antarctica is a polar desert. The Sahara is the largest hot desert, but Antarctica is the largest desert overall.

answers.comment: The Sahara is the world's largest hot desert, but not the largest desert overall.
The Gobi is a large desert in Asia.
The Arabian Desert is one of the largest hot deserts.
Correct! Antarctica is the largest desert in the world.

questions.question: Which European country has the greatest number of natural lakes?
questions.hint: This Nordic country is famous for its thousands of lakes and forests.
questions.explanation: Finland is often called the Land of a Thousand Lakes, although the exact count depends on the minimum lake size used.

answers.comment: Sweden has many lakes, but Finland is famous for having an exceptionally high lake count.
Correct! Finland is renowned for its vast number of lakes.
Norway is famous for its fjords and mountainous landscape.
Iceland has numerous lakes, but far fewer than Finland.

questions.question: Which two countries share the longest international land border in the world?
questions.hint: One is the world's second-largest country by land area, and the other is its southern neighbour.
questions.explanation: The Canada–United States border is approximately 8,891 kilometres long, including the Alaska–Canada section.

answers.comment: Their border is long, but it is shorter than the Canada–United States border.
This is one of the longest borders in South America.
Correct! Canada and the United States share the world's longest international land border.
Their border is long and disputed, but it is not the longest.

questions.question: Which of the following countries is crossed by both the Equator and the Tropic of Capricorn?
questions.hint: Look for a large South American country that stretches across much of the continent.
questions.explanation: Brazil is crossed by the Equator in the north and the Tropic of Capricorn in the south.

answers.comment: Argentina is crossed by the Tropic of Capricorn but not the Equator.
Correct! Brazil is crossed by both the Equator and the Tropic of Capricorn.
Peru is crossed by the Equator's general region only outside its territory; it is not crossed by the Tropic of Capricorn.
Colombia is crossed by the Equator but not the Tropic of Capricorn.
